# TheStatusQ

> A copywriting and web design studio run by Quinn Crowell. We build lifecycle email programs, conversion-focused websites, and video sales letter scripts for consumer brands and small businesses.

TheStatusQ is a small studio, not an agency network. Quinn Crowell is the founder and does the work. We work remotely with clients in the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada.

- Website: https://www.thestatusq.io
- Contact: hello@thestatusq.io
- Founder LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/quinnctsq

## What we do

- **Lifecycle email and Klaviyo.** Welcome, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase and win-back flows built in Klaviyo, plus ongoing campaign copy. Klaviyo setup runs $300 to $500. An ongoing email copywriting retainer is $800 per month for 3 to 5 emails a week, two-month minimum.
- **Websites and landing pages.** Static and Next.js builds. A single landing page is $1,500. A starter funnel bundling a landing page, Klaviyo setup with UTM tracking and a five-email sequence is $2,200. A full package with a site, copy, a VSL script and a five-email sequence runs $3,500 to $5,000.
- **VSL scripts.** Video sales letter scripts for a specific offer.
- **Ongoing maintenance.** A $250 per month retainer covering hosting, security and three content updates a month.

## How we work

Discovery call, then a written brief, then build, then a review round, then deploy. Most single-page builds take about a week. A multi-page site takes two to four weeks depending on how fast content comes back.

## Accessibility

Builds run an automated accessibility check before they ship and target WCAG 2.1 Level AA. We do not install accessibility overlay widgets, because they do not fix the underlying markup.

- [Homepage](https://www.thestatusq.io/): services, process, pricing context and a nine-question FAQ.
